notes.title: Patch 1.05 Update - Double Trouble
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]
[h2]New Game mode[/h2]
[h3]Duo mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 Players per team. (2v2)
[*] Each player can ban 2 Zlimes and pick 2 Zlimes.
[*] All Zlimes will enter the arena at the same times. (which mean 4v4 Zlimes in the arena)
[*] Zlimes that being sent by the same player will be spawn adjacent with each other.
[*] A player can choose if they want to be front-line player or back-line player.
[*] If both players in the same team choose the same position, it will determine by the order when joining team in the lobby.
[*] Money and items cannot be shared with the teammate.
[/list]

[h3]Avatar System[/h3]
[*] The avatar can be customized in Player Stats menu.
[*] 6 Faces / 8 Eyes / 3 Noses / 4 Mouths / 2 Hats / 1 Accessory
[*] You can change the color of face, eyes and nose.

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lobby can be started with bots, allowing 2 players to play co-op against bots.
[*] Only lobby can change mode. The normal play mode can only play normal mode.
[*] Change file name, so some settings might reset. (Sorry for inconvenience)
[*] Fix some bugs / Update UI
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03 Update - Multiplayer System
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enable the multiplayer system. (Currently only 1v1 is available)
[*] Accuracy has been split into "Physical Accuracy" and "Magical Accuracy" [expand type=details]
Crimson Blade -> Physical Accuracy
Eye Staff -> Magic Accuracy
Blind (Fog - Mist Zlime) -> Both
[/expand]
[*] Evasion has been split into "Physical Evasion" and "Magical Evasion" [expand type=details]
Wind Evasiveness (Wind Zlime) -> Physical Evasion
Ring of Wind -> Physical Evasion
[/expand]
[*] The calculation for every frames should update at fixed interval of 0.02 seconds.
[*] Stat conversion (Ex. Trick Zlime, Lunar Blade) should works correctly.
[*] Base money per round increased from 45 to 48
[*] Increment money per round increased from 10 to 12
[*] Base money losing bonus increased from 5 to 7
[*] Various improvements [expand type=spoiler]I forgot to note them ;P[/expand]
[/list]

[*] Dark Zlime : Shadow Bat speed increased from 10 to 14

[*] Fire Zlime : Firball damage increased from 15-25 to 25-35
